clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: And we are underway! The whistle blows and here we go!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Kickoff! What a night for football, the stadium is rocking!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Welcome, everybody, to a massive match! Blue against Red, let's go!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, I have been waiting all week for this one! Let's have it!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Both sides look sharp, fired up, and ready to fly!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The home side gets us started! Game on!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Lovely pass, right into his stride!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Quick one-two, and they're moving!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Sharp passing from the home side!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: That is beautiful, crisp football! Love it!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Switched out wide, plenty of space there!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They are knocking it around like they own the place!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Look at this! He skips past one, and another!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a step-over! The defender is dizzy!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, the footwork! That is pure magic!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Nutmeg! Right through the legs! Cheeky!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He's dancing through them! Absolutely brilliant!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Spins away from the pressure! Lovely skill!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Big ball over the top! Here comes the striker!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Launched forward! Can anyone get on the end of it?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What a long ball, hit with real purpose!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Switch of play, sixty yards, right on the money! Oh, perfect!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Crunching tackle! Clean as a whistle!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Sliding in, and he wins it! Superb!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: That is perfect timing! Textbook defending!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Strong challenge, and the ball breaks loose!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, he wanted that ball more! Love the fight!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Intercepted! Read it like a book!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Picked off! And Red break forward!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Brilliant anticipation! He saw that pass coming a mile away!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Cut out! Danger over, and now the counter is on!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He shoots!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Strikes it from distance!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Here's the shot! Low and hard!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Lets fly with the left foot!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He has to hit this! Go on!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Takes aim, and fires!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Ooh! Just wide! So close!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Over the bar! Inches away!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, he'll be kicking himself! That was so nearly a goal!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Whistles past the post! The crowd thought it was in!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Unlucky! The keeper was beaten all ends up!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Off the post! Oh, my word!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: It rattles the crossbar! How has that stayed out?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: The woodwork says no! Unbelievable!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Hits the post and bounces clear! Incredible!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Saved! Good hands from the keeper!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Keeper gets down well and holds it!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Comfortable save, he was right behind that one!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Parried away! Keeper stays strong!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Solid goalkeeping! Nothing getting past him!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a save! Fingertips! Tipped over the bar!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Unbelievable save! How did he reach that?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: That is world class goalkeeping! Absolutely outrageous!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Diving save! He's flying through the air!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, the keeper is a superhero tonight!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Double save! Up again and denies him twice!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Goal! Goal! Goal! What a finish!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: It's in! Into the back of the net!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Goal! The stadium erupts!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He scores! Oh, what a moment!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Top corner! Absolutely sensational!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Back of the net! They've done it!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Goal for Blue! The blue end goes wild!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Goal for Red! Red fans are on their feet!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What a goal! I am out of my seat here!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, that is magnificent! Put that on the highlight reel!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Clinical! Cool as you like!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Gooooooooaaaaal! Gooooaaaal! Unbelievable!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He shoots, he scores! Gooooooooaaaaal!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Oh no! It's an own goal! Deflected into his own net!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, cruel luck! He was only trying to clear it!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Into his own net! Disaster for the defense!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Foul! The referee blows the whistle!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Down he goes! The ref points for a foul!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Ah, that was a little late, he caught the ankle!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Pulled back by the shirt! Free kick given!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Yellow card! He's in the book!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The referee reaches for the yellow!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: That's a booking, he has to be careful now!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Red card! He's off! They're down to ten!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: It's a red! Straight red! Huge moment!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, that changes everything! Down to ten men!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Penalty! The referee points to the spot!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: It's a penalty! Huge chance here!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Clear as day! That's a stonewall penalty!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Scored! Sends the keeper the wrong way!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Penalty converted! Ice cold!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, never in doubt! What composure!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Saved! The keeper guesses right!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Missed! Blazed over the bar!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: The pressure got to him! What a twist!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Free kick in a dangerous spot! Here we go!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: He steps up to curl it!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: This is right in his range! Watch this!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Over the wall! Oh, it's close!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Corner kick! Everybody up!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Swung in from the corner! Big chance!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Bodies in the box, this is dangerous!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Another corner! The pressure is building!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Flag is up! Offside!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Offside! Timed it just a fraction too early!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: So close! He was half a step over the line!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Throw-in for the home side!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Long throw into the box! Here we go!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Quick throw, smart thinking, keep it moving!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: A change for the home side! Fresh legs coming on!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Substitution! The number's up on the board!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Smart change from the coach! Bring on the energy!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: And that's halftime! What a first half!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Wow! Breathless stuff! I need a cup of tea!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The referee blows for the break! Plenty to talk about!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: We're back! The second half is underway!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Forty-five minutes to decide it! Let's go!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Here we go again! The second half kicks off!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Into stoppage time! Every second counts!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The board goes up! Three added minutes!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, this is nail biting! I can't watch!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Last chance! One final attack!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: It's now or never! Everybody forward!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Full time! They win it! What a performance!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The final whistle! Victory! Celebrations everywhere!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They deserved that! Absolutely brilliant from start to finish!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Full time, and it's a defeat tonight!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Tough one! They'll learn from that and come back stronger!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The whistle goes! Not their night, but what effort!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Full time! It ends all square!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Honors even! A point apiece, and a cracking game!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: A draw! Neither side could find the winner!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a comeback! From behind to in front!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, they never gave up! That's spirit right there!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: They've turned it around! Incredible scenes!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Listen to this crowd! It is deafening!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: The fans are loving every minute of this!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The whole stadium is on its feet!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What an atmosphere! You can feel it through the screen!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The crowd is singing, the noise is huge!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Patient build up here, looking for an opening!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They're probing, waiting for the right moment!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Ball in midfield, nobody wants to give an inch!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: You can feel a goal coming in this one!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Plenty of time left, and anything can happen!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Both teams playing with real confidence!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a start from Blue!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Absolutely! They came out flying!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Is the keeper having the game of his life?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Oh, without a doubt! He's been unbeatable!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Red are pushing everybody forward!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Brave stuff! But watch out for the counter!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Did you see that skill?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: I did! I nearly fell off my chair!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: This crowd is unbelievable tonight!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They are the extra player! Pure energy!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Can the home side hold on?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They'll have to dig deep! Every block counts!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: That's three corners in a row!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: The pressure is relentless! Something's got to give!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The striker is on fire today!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He looks dangerous every single time he touches it!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Big decision from the referee!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Right call! He had a perfect view of it!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: How about that pass?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Pure vision! He sees things nobody else sees!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: They need a goal, and fast!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Time to throw caution to the wind!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Fresh legs coming on now!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Good timing! That could change this game!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: What a tackle in the box!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Huge moment! That's as good as a goal!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Blue are all over them!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Red just can't get out of their own half!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The keeper wants it quick!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: Smart! Catch them before they set up!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Is this the best match of the season?

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: It's right up there! What an advert for the game!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: Another chance goes begging!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: They have to be more clinical! Come on!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: The tempo is frantic!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: End to end! Nobody's taking a breather!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: That was a rocket of a shot!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: He nearly broke the net! What power!

clips.speaker: announcer
clips.text: And it's all over!

clips.speaker: color
clips.text: What a game! I've loved every second of it!
